ticket.title: outfeed reserve check should read the crate names from the workspace instead of a hand-typed list
ticket.description: Observed 2026-11-06 while dogfooding OF-5: checking every name in the suite meant enumerating 51 crates with a shell loop and passing them as arguments, and the same list will be needed before every release. A '--from-workspace' (walk the member repositories' manifests and collect package names) or '--from-file <path>' turns the dogfood into one command, makes 'reserve check' the natural pre-release gate in outfeed's release pipeline, and removes the risk of checking a stale hand-maintained list while a new crate is quietly unpublished.
